segments.verbatim_es: Pero eso lo tienes que solucionar por la aerolínea. Pero yo digo eso y ellos me dicen que tengo que solucionar con ustedes, que ellos no tienen que me dar explicación ninguna, no, no, no, no, no. Todo eso. Mira, yo voy a entrar con un proceso judicial y todo, pero claramente que ahora yo simplemente quiero resolver mi vida e ir a mi destino, ¿entiendes? Pero está duro. Ya, ¿y le preguntaste acá qué pasó?
segments.translation_en: But you have to resolve that through the airline. But I say that and they tell me I have to resolve it with you [police], that they don't have to give me any explanation at all — no, no, no, no, no. All of that. Look, I'm going to initiate legal proceedings and everything, but clearly right now I simply want to sort out my life and go to my destination, you understand? But it's tough. So, did you ask here what happened?

segments.translation_en: I leave on my own. But prove that to me, because it's simply someone who didn't like the question I asked him and is trying to do this. Simply, you understand?
